EmailTemplate.subject: Tired of opening bank accounts in every new market?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, Your treasury peers are taking a hard look at their processes for global operations. I hear too often from treasury folks the following challenges:
- Too many bank accounts needed to maintain global payments (including new bank account openings when expanding to new markets) - Complex and expensive cross-border transactions - Manual and time-consuming exchange rate monitoring
Flywire solves this. You can plug into Flywire’s payment network <[[https://www.flywire.com/platform/global-payment-network?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> and eliminate unnecessary and complicated banking relationships to simplify your global payments ecosystem. With over 240 countries and 140 currencies, our payment network can accommodate use cases on a wide range of business needs. What’s more, we take on the FX burden for you.
Schedule time with me today to learn how we can help save you and your team the hassle of opening up new bank accounts and entities.
Thank you, Logan Strickland
